name: Gantt / Transaction Timetable
name_zh: 交易时间表 / 甘特图
summary: Process timetable: tasks grouped by workstream, bars coloured by phase, milestone diamonds, two-tier calendar header, today line and time zoom.
summary_zh: 交易流程时间表：按工作流分组的任务条（按阶段着色）、里程碑菱形、双层日历表头、“今天”线与时间缩放。
description_zh: 投行交易流程页（出售流程、IPO、再融资）的标准时间表。每行一个任务，按工作流（encode.group）分组并带粗体分组标题行与汇总括线；任务条按阶段（encode.phase）着色并在左上角给出图例；milestone 为 true 或开始=结束日期的任务画成菱形并标注日期。顶部为双层日历表头（月/周起始日，随缩放自动切换为年/月或年/季度），可用 today 画出“今天”竖线并淡化已过去的时间段。鼠标悬停显示起止日期、工期（天/周）和负责人；点击任务或分组标题可按工作流交叉筛选其他组件；滚轮或底部滑块缩放时间轴。
best_for: Regulatory approval tracks with key dates
Showing where the process stands today
avoid_when: More than ~35 task rows on one page (summarise by workstream)
Only a handful of dated events without durations (use timeline)

group.desc: Workstream used for grouping rows and header rows

label.desc: Task name shown on the row axis

end.desc: End date (inclusive); missing or equal to start = milestone

phase.desc: Phase used for bar colour and the legend

milestone.desc: Explicit milestone flag (diamond instead of bar)

owner.desc: Responsible party, shown in the tooltip (or as bar label via barLabel)

today.desc: Date of the vertical 'today' line ('YYYY-MM-DD' or 'now'); null hides it

todayLabel.desc: Text under the today line (date is appended)

shadePast.desc: Shade the elapsed period left of the today line

groupHeaders.desc: Bold workstream header rows (otherwise groups are separated by a rule)

summary.desc: Summary bracket from first start to last end on each header row

sort.desc: 'start' orders workstreams and tasks by start date; 'data' keeps dataset order

palette.desc: Phase colours: categorical | sequential (ordered phases in shades of the theme ramp)

milestoneLabel.desc: Text right of each diamond: date | label | none

barLabel.desc: Field shown right of each bar (e.g. 'owner'), 'duration', or null

endInclusive.desc: Treat the end date as the last day of the task (bar runs to the end of that day)

calendar.desc: Header granularity: auto | weeks (months / week-commencing) | months (years / months) | quarters

weekStart.desc: First day of the week for week-commencing labels: 1 = Monday, 0 = Sunday

domain.desc: [start, end] fixed time window; default = whole months around the data

labelWidth.desc: Row label column width in px, or 'auto' (longest label, max 38% of the width)

dateFormat.desc: Tooltip date format; defaults to the start field format

selectBy.desc: Channel used for click-to-filter and highlighting: group | phase | label | null

zoom.desc: Time zoom (wheel / pinch + slider); the calendar header re-tiers as you zoom

interactions: Tooltip with start / end dates, duration in days and weeks, owner and status vs. today
Click a task or a workstream label to cross-filter by workstream (others dim)
Wheel / pinch / slider zoom on the time axis; header switches between weeks, months and quarters
Staggered bar wipe-in and milestone pop on entry; smooth updates on filter changes
